paper_title: RATIO: A Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations in Scientific Literature
reason: RATIO는 영어로 된 과학 논문 문장을 대상으로 한 텍스트 검색 벤치마크로, en 트랙·text 모달리티의 재사용 가능한 새 벤치마크로 보입니다. 규모와 지표도 확인됩니다. 3,017,476개 질의-정답 쌍, silver 테스트 질의 17,579개, 후보 풀 404,371문장, MRR@10 등입니다. 다만 제공된 PDF 텍스트에는 공식 데이터나 코드의 URL이 없습니다. 첫 페이지에 'Project', 'Github', 'Data & Models'라는 링크 라벨만 있고 주소는 추출되지 않았습니다. 본문과 부록에 나오는 URL은 파인튜닝에 쓴 외부 모델(all-mpnet-base-v2, ModernBERT-embed-large, Stella)의 Hugging Face 페이지뿐입니다. PDF가 직접 밝힌 공식 리소스 URL이 없으므로 링크 필드를 채울 수 없어 propose하지 않고 needs_evidence로 둡니다. 하이퍼링크 대상 URL을 확인하면 행을 제안할 수 있습니다.

screening.paper_title: RATIO: A Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations in Scientific Literature
screening.abstract: Retrieved scientific literature can serve as inspiration for both human and AI scientists. Inspiration can take different forms: prior work may directly suggest how to address a problem, or surface directions at different levels of abstraction---zooming out to a more general view or zooming in to a concrete realization. We introduce RATIO (Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations), a large-scale benchmark in which relevance is defined by three operations which we name ideation moves: Address retrieves potential approaches for stated problems, Broaden retrieves more general formulations, and Specify retrieves concrete instantiations. RATIO is constructed from millions of full-text scientific papers across CS literature via a general recipe that extends discourse-marker distant supervision---previously used only for classification---to corpus-scale retrieval, combined with extensive LLM and human vetting. Experiments show that operation-specific fine-tuning substantially boosts retrievers and LLM reranking helps further, but much room for improvement remains. Researchers blind to condition found the fine-tuned retriever's candidates more useful as inspirations. RATIO provides a scalable training and evaluation framework for retrieval components that support literature-grounded ideation, opening up new research avenues in scientific inspiration retrieval. We release full data, code, models, and annotations.
